title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11
taper: Thanks to Bob Murphy for the Seed Disks

ai_review.summary: A sweet, secret‑gem show captured on a pristine soundboard recording; the second set shines even though it’s out of order.
ai_review.review: This fan‑rated five‑star performance is described as “so sweet” and ranks alongside legendary shows like 2/15/73. The soundboard source delivers clear, well‑balanced audio, and despite the second set being presented out of its original sequence, the music’s flow remains compelling.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed five‑star review; strong praise for both performance and sound quality suggests a near‑top rating, but limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific complaints; reviewers highlight the recording’s clarity and sweetness. Note: second set tracks are out of show order in this release.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is presented out of its original sequence, but listeners find the flow still engaging and enjoyable.
